name: Goat
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, languages, or special senses.
appearance: A cream-colored goat with cloven hooves, a short beard, and narrow horns sweeping backward.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), p. 138, Goat.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Ram on the same turn. The hit deals an extra 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength save or fall prone.
Sure-Footed. Roll Strength and Dexterity saves with advantage when the effect would knock the goat prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Charge adds its damage to the Ram hit even if the creature passes its save. On a charge hit, roll 2d4 + 1 total bludgeoning damage.

name: Quipper
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 8. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A compact predatory fish with sharp teeth, gray-green scales, and reddish fins.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), p. 150, Quipper.
sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature below its hit point maximum.
Water Breathing. The quipper breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
sections.At the table: The quipper has a 40-ft. swim speed and no walking speed. Bite damage is a fixed 1 on a hit.
